research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Electronic Arts is researching systems for video game replay editing and cinematic replay, interactive gameplay playback, and videographer and spectator modes in online games. It develops route generation systems within virtual sports environments, goal driven animation and character controllers using motion variational autoencoders, and style-controlled generation of visual assets for video games using machine learning. Work also covers state stream game engines for decoupled simulation and rendering in game applications. These efforts span gameplay capture, animation, content generation and engine architecture.
